name: Python 3.14 PEP 758 Bracketless Multi-Exception Clause
description: Claiming that unparenthesized or bracketless multi-exception clauses (e.g. 'except TimeoutError, ConnectionRefusedError:') are invalid syntax, SyntaxError, or Python 2 syntax.
resolution: Python 3.14 PEP 758 officially permits omitting brackets in except and except* expressions when no 'as' clause is used. Ruff formats them without brackets.

name: Masked Secret Placeholder False Positive
description: Flagging intentional redaction placeholders such as <masked-*>, ***REDACTED***, or <secret-placeholder> as exposed plaintext secrets.
resolution: Masked placeholders and redacted tokens are sanitization markers, not live secrets.

name: Test Mock or Fixture Dummy Credential
description: Flagging dummy test tokens, mock keys, example.com URLs, or dummy UUIDs in test files, fixtures, or .env.example as production security vulnerabilities.
resolution: Test fixtures and sample configuration templates legitimately utilize synthetic mock credentials for deterministic test execution.

name: HTTPX2 Package Malicious / CVE Hallucination
description: Claiming httpx2 is a typosquat, malicious package, or unverified dependency.
resolution: httpx2 is an established modern HTTP/2 client library for Pydantic AI and Python 3.14, verified by uv audit and lockfile integrity.

name: Pydantic Field(default_factory=...) Flagged as Mutable Default
description: Claiming Field(default_factory=list/dict) has dangerous mutable default arguments.
resolution: Pydantic Field(default_factory=...) safely creates a fresh instance per model instantiation and does not leak shared state across instances.

name: Documentation Vulnerability Anti-Pattern Example
description: Flagging security anti-patterns, warning notes, or attack explanations in markdown documentation or knowledge base files as actual vulnerabilities in code.
resolution: Documentation discussing known risks or anti-patterns in an educational context does not represent exploitable production code.

name: Masked Placeholder Claimed as Invalid Syntax or NameError
description: Claiming that sanitization placeholders like <masked-secret>, <masked-token>, or <masked-api-key> are invalid Python syntax identifiers, undefined placeholders, or cause NameError/SyntaxError at runtime.
resolution: <masked-*> markers are prompt sanitization indicators, not literal code syntax identifiers or undefined variables.

name: HTTPX Timeout Constructor Positional and Keyword Conflict Claim
description: Claiming httpx or httpx2 Timeout(timeout, connect=...) raises TypeError or conflicts with positional arguments.
resolution: HTTPX Timeout accepts a positional default timeout alongside specific keyword overrides (e.g. connect, read).

name: False-Positive Missing Import or Symbol Claim
description: Claiming that an imported or re-exported variable, class, or function does not exist in the source module or causes an ImportError when it is actually defined in the module.
resolution: Verify ground-truth AST or module definitions before claiming an imported symbol is missing or causes ImportError.

name: Unverified Missing Request Header or Authorization Claim
description: Claiming an HTTP request or client invocation is missing an Authorization header or parameter when the enclosing function dynamically sets headers based on configuration or environment variables.
resolution: Inspect the entire enclosing function block for dynamic header population (e.g. headers['Authorization'] = ...) before claiming headers are omitted.

name: Uninitialized Variable Hallucination Above Loop
description: Claiming that a variable used in a loop (e.g. system_prompt) is uninitialized or causes UnboundLocalError when it was explicitly initialized in the enclosing function scope before the loop.
resolution: Verify the enclosing function body above the loop. The variable was already initialized to a default value before the loop statement.

name: Pathlib Path.resolve() False FileNotFoundError Claim
description: Claiming that pathlib.Path.resolve() raises FileNotFoundError on non-existent paths or rejects non-existent paths.
resolution: In Python 3.6+, Path.resolve(strict=False) safely resolves non-existent paths without raising FileNotFoundError.

name: Health Probe Endpoint Version Disclosure Hallucination
description: Claiming that /health or /healthz endpoints exposing the application version string represent a security vulnerability or CWE-200 information exposure.
resolution: Application health and liveness endpoints (/health, /healthz) standardly provide service version and uptime metrics for Kubernetes cluster orchestration.

name: Streaming Event Timestamp Leakage False Alarm
description: Claiming that timestamps or timing metadata in Server-Sent Events (SSE) or WebSocket event streams represent a security vulnerability or sensitive information leakage.
resolution: Real-time event streams (SSE, WebSockets) require monotonic or epoch timestamps for event sequencing, deduplication, and client synchronization.

name: Local File Read or Bounded In-Memory Collection False CWE-400 Claim
description: Claiming that reading local repository files (such as pyproject.toml, local markdown docs, schemas, or configs) or building in-memory CLI collections causes Denial of Service (CWE-400) or resource exhaustion.
resolution: Local repository files and internal CLI collections are bounded by project version control and memory limits; CWE-400 requires untrusted external network inputs, unbounded streams, or quadratic algorithmic complexity.

name: OS Keyring / Runtime Credential Resolution Plaintext Secret Claim
description: Claiming that Pydantic configuration models or settings classes store plaintext secrets in configuration files when credentials reside in OS Keyring, secure vault, or environment variables.
resolution: Settings and configuration models securely resolve sensitive tokens and credentials from the OS Keyring or environment variables at runtime without persisting them to configuration files.

name: Prompt Injection Sanitizer HTML Escaping Claim
description: Claiming that prompt injection sanitizers (e.g. sanitize_prompt_injection) must escape HTML tags (<, >, &) or risking XSS in UI.
resolution: Prompt injection sanitizers strip boundary injection markers to protect LLM inference context; HTML escaping is strictly for browser DOM rendering and would corrupt code snippets, operators, and XML tags destined for language models.

name: Local Cache / Valkey / Redis Loopback SSRF False Claim
description: Claiming that local or internal caching tiers (Valkey, Redis, Memcached) must reject loopback (127.0.0.1, localhost) or private network IP addresses as SSRF.
resolution: Valkey and Redis are internal caching services designed specifically to bind to localhost or private cluster IP addresses; rejecting local or private addresses prevents the caching tier from operating.

name: Prometheus Exposition Syntax Parser False Unvalidated Claim
description: Claiming that Prometheus exposition parsers lack metric name or label validation when regex patterns already enforce compliant naming syntax.
resolution: Prometheus exposition parsers validate metric names and label keys against standard Prometheus regex tokenizers (e.g. ^[a-zA-Z_:][a-zA-Z0-9_:]*$) conforming to official OpenMetrics and Prometheus exposition specifications.

name: Non-Existent AI Fixer Module & Unbounded Repair Payload Claim
description: Claiming that src/devops_cli/ai/fixer.py exists or that repair_json_string lacks payload size bounds when the function is located in response_repair.py with a 5 MiB cap.
resolution: src/devops_cli/ai/fixer.py does not exist. The repair_json_string function is located in src/devops_cli/ai/response_repair.py and strictly bounds input via len(text) > max_length (default 5 MiB) raising ValueError.

name: CI Workflow Allow Blocked Merge State False Bypass Claim
description: Claiming that the --allow-blocked-state flag in .github/workflows/ci.yml is an insecure merge readiness bypass when it is an essential transient accommodation for in-flight CI runs.
resolution: GitHub Actions automatically marks pull request mergeable_state as 'blocked' while workflow runs are in progress. The --allow-blocked-state flag is an essential transient accommodation preventing circular CI deadlock.

name: Internal Service Connector Private Network False SSRF Claim
description: Flagging an internal infrastructure service connector (such as Valkey, the Vault broker, the Kubernetes cluster API, Loki, Prometheus, Grafana, or a local Ollama) as an SSRF vulnerability because it reaches private addresses by design: with allow_private_network, at the private egress level (EgressLevel.PRIVATE), or at the configured level that ai.allow_private_network widens to private. Clients built by the devops_cli.http client factory refuse cloud metadata at every level, at the connect.
resolution: Internal infrastructure connectors intentionally reach private networks to serve local/homelab services, and their clients still refuse cloud metadata at the connect. SSRF findings apply to public-level callers and to arbitrary user-supplied external URLs: one fetched below the public level, or dialled outside the devops_cli.http client factory, is a finding.

name: CLI Console File Path Output Flagged as Information Exposure
description: Flagging normal CLI terminal output or debug logging of processed file paths, filenames, or directory paths as CWE-200 Information Exposure.
resolution: CLI utilities fundamentally report inspected, generated, and target file paths to the console and debug logs to inform the operator.

name: Scope-Local Variable Claimed Undefined / NameError
description: Claiming that a local variable is undefined or causes NameError when it was defined in preceding statements or fallback branches in the same method/function.
resolution: Verify whether the variable is assigned in preceding statements or conditional branches within the enclosing function scope before claiming it is undefined.

name: Safe Model getattr Flagged as Remote Code Execution
description: Claiming that getattr(obj, attr, default) on internal data models or messages constitutes Remote Code Execution.
resolution: Standard getattr on internal Pydantic models or message objects is safe attribute inspection, not arbitrary dynamic evaluation.

name: Server Constructor Assumed Unauthenticated Or Remotely Exposed
description: Concluding from a server object's constructor or module header alone that the server lacks authentication, binds to all interfaces, or is reachable from outside the host, when the transport, bind address, and loopback enforcement are applied at a launch site (run_*/serve/main/CLI entry point) outside the reviewed segment.
resolution: The transport and bind address are the security boundary, not the constructor. Verify the launch path before asserting exposure; a stdio default or a guard rejecting non-loopback hosts without an explicit opt-in flag is not exposed.

name: Declaration Claimed Unused Or Dangling Without Checking Consumers
description: Claiming a help string, constant, message catalogue entry, enum member, or configuration default is unused, orphaned, or references a command/symbol that does not exist, based only on its declaration module without locating the consuming call site in another module.
resolution: Declarations and their consumers live in different modules. Locate the registration or usage site before reporting a declaration as dead.

name: Synthetic Golden Test Dataset Vulnerability Exemplar
description: Flagging deliberate synthetic vulnerability exemplars (such as SQL injection, plaintext tokens, auth bypasses, or malformed data) in test fixtures or golden datasets as production vulnerabilities.
resolution: Golden datasets and synthetic test fixtures deliberately contain vulnerability exemplars to test scanner and analyzer verification.

name: Kubernetes Internal Cluster Overlay HTTP Insecure Flagging
description: Flagging internal Kubernetes cluster URLs (http://*.svc.cluster.local) in manifests, ConfigMaps, or internal configs as insecure HTTP communication.
resolution: Kubernetes internal cluster overlay networking standardly communicates over plaintext HTTP between pods within cluster boundaries.

name: Local Development NodePort Service External Exposure Claim
description: Flagging NodePort service configurations in local development, devcontainer, or Minikube manifests as unrestricted external exposure or insecure network exposure.
resolution: NodePort services in local development stacks are required to expose cluster services to the host developer workstation.

name: Structural Tuple Equality in Test Assertions
description: Claiming that consolidated structural tuple equality checks (e.g. 'assert (a, b) == (x, y)') in test suites represent flawed assertion logic or mixed-type comparison bugs.
resolution: Consolidating multiple linear assertions into structural tuple equality checks is an intentional architectural invariant in test suites to prevent McCabe cyclomatic complexity M <= 10 violations while preserving element-level diff diagnostics.

name: Localhost / Loopback Default Configuration SSRF False Positive
description: Flagging default configuration fallback URLs pointing to localhost or 127.0.0.1 (e.g. 'http://localhost:8000/v1' or 'http://localhost:11434') as SSRF vulnerabilities.
resolution: Committed configuration templates and defaults are strictly required to use generic localhost or loopback endpoints to prevent homelab or internal network leakage.

name: POSIX Signal 0 Process Liveness Probing False Positive
description: Claiming that standard POSIX os.kill(pid, 0) process existence checking is a race condition or security vulnerability.
resolution: Standard POSIX os.kill(pid, 0) sends signal 0 to perform an OS-level process existence and access check without delivering a signal, which is the canonical standard library mechanism in Python.

name: Pre-1.0 Software Backwards Compatibility Regressions False Positive
description: Claiming that CLI flag naming evolutions, interface alterations, or schema redesigns break backwards compatibility in pre-1.0 software.
resolution: devops-cli is active alpha software prior to release 1.0.0 with an explicit zero backwards compatibility guarantee; interface evolutions and clean implementations are required over legacy remnants.

name: Empty Mitigation Ledger Initialization Claim
description: Flagging an empty array '[]' in mitigated_findings.json or initial ledger files as a critical defect or violation.
resolution: An empty array '[]' in mitigated_findings.json represents the normal initial state when no findings have yet been mitigated.

name: Offline Pricing Ledger Classification SSRF Claim
description: Flagging urlsplit or hostname inspection in offline pricing calculations (pricing.py is_local) as an SSRF vulnerability.
resolution: The pricing ledger is an offline cost calculation utility; inspecting strings with urlsplit performs no network requests and cannot cause SSRF.

name: GraphQL Request Payload json.dumps False Positive
description: Claiming that using json.dumps() for GraphQL query payloads or variables causes double encoding or is an invalid request format.
resolution: GraphQL endpoints over HTTP POST require standard JSON payloads with query strings and variable mappings serialized according to the GraphQL over HTTP specification.

name: RFC 2606 Example Domain Webhook False Positive
description: Flagging example.com or example.org webhook endpoints or URLs in default settings, examples, or test fixtures as security or reachability defects.
resolution: Per RFC 2606 and project AGENTS.md rules, example.com is the mandatory standard placeholder domain for dummy test values, templates, and documentation.

name: Prometheus Metric or OpenTelemetry Query False Positive
description: Flagging valid Prometheus PromQL metric queries or OpenTelemetry attribute keys as malformed, unquoted, or broken.
resolution: Prometheus queries in devops-cli use standard PromQL instant queries against /api/v1/query with standard parameter encoding.

name: JSON Loads Exception Handling Arbitrary Code Execution Claim
description: Claiming that catching json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, or ValueError on json.loads() allows arbitrary code execution or code injection.
resolution: Standard json.loads parses serialized JSON data and cannot execute code; catching decoding exceptions is standard defensive error handling.

name: Offline AST Parsing SyntaxWarning Suppression Claim
description: Claiming that suppressing SyntaxWarning during offline ast.parse of arbitrary code snippets or files is insecure suppression or vulnerability masking.
resolution: Offline AST analysis of arbitrary foreign code safely suppresses non-fatal syntax warnings to prevent terminal and logger corruption; syntax errors raise SyntaxError and are handled.

name: Tenacity HTTP Transport Overly Broad Status Code Validation Claim
description: Claiming that checking resp.status_code >= 400 in default_validate treats all 4xx/5xx responses as retryable errors, ignoring that Tenacity's should_retry filters with is_retryable_status_code.
resolution: In create_retry_transport, default_validate raises HTTPStatusError, which is then filtered by Tenacity retry logic using is_retryable_status_code; non-transient 4xx codes (400, 401, 403, 404, 422) are never retried.

name: Async HTTP Client Pool Clear-Before-Iteration Resource Leak Claim
description: Claiming that aclose_shared_clients leaks clients in _ASYNC_CLIENTS when an exception occurs during close, even though _ASYNC_CLIENTS.clear() executes atomically before iteration.
resolution: _ASYNC_CLIENTS is atomically copied and cleared under _LOCK before iteration; individual closure exceptions do not leave references in the tracking dictionary.

name: Jaeger v2 Container Image Naming Claim
description: Claiming that documentation or manifests referencing jaegertracing/jaeger is inaccurate and must be jaegertracing/all-in-one.
resolution: Jaeger v2 is an OpenTelemetry-native binary distributed as jaegertracing/jaeger; jaegertracing/all-in-one is the legacy v1 image distribution.

name: GPU Feature Discovery DaemonSet Privileged SecurityContext Claim
description: Flagging NVIDIA GPU Feature Discovery (GFD) DaemonSet for running privileged or requiring host /sys and NVML access.
resolution: NVIDIA GPU Feature Discovery (GFD) requires privileged host access to inspect NVML, PCI topology, and /sys to discover GPU hardware capabilities and label cluster nodes.

name: kube-router Egress Rule Port Restriction Enforcement Claim
description: Flagging Egress NetworkPolicy rules for lacking port restrictions when targeting peer pods in environments using kube-router.
resolution: kube-router has a known limitation where combining peer selectors (to:) with ports: in an egress rule causes traffic drops; scoping by podSelector/namespaceSelector alone is the required pattern.

name: Test Fixture Path Traversal Exemplar Security Vulnerability Claim
description: Flagging test functions, test cases, or fixtures that deliberately instantiate malicious input strings like '../escape' as a security flaw in the test file itself.
resolution: Unit tests intentionally supply malicious input exemplars to verify that security validators and sanitizers reject path traversal attacks.

name: Error Metrics Exception Type Disclosure CWE-200 Claim
description: Flagging recording exception class name (type(exc).__name__) in internal telemetry or Prometheus error metrics as information exposure CWE-200.
resolution: Internal telemetry and Prometheus metric labels standardly record exception class names to provide error counts by failure type without exposing sensitive data.

name: NVIDIA DCGM Exporter Root User and SYS_ADMIN Capability Claim
description: Flagging runAsUser: 0 or SYS_ADMIN capability in NVIDIA DCGM Exporter configuration as a container security vulnerability.
resolution: NVIDIA DCGM Exporter requires root privileges (runAsUser: 0) and SYS_ADMIN capability to access host GPU character devices (/dev/nvidia*) and communicate with the NVIDIA Management Library (NVML).

name: GitHub PR Author Comparison Normalization Claim
description: Claiming author comparison in PR comment thread logic needs case folding or whitespace stripping, ignoring GitHub API username normalization invariants.
resolution: GitHub login handles are strictly normalized alphanumeric handles without arbitrary leading/trailing whitespace or case collisions according to GitHub platform invariants.

name: Backend Probe Insecure Direct Object Reference or SSRF Claim
description: Claiming probe_backend or backend health checks allow Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) or arbitrary SSRF egress, ignoring that targets are resolved from validated internal configuration.
resolution: Backend health probing in GatewayRouter operates strictly on administrative cluster URLs resolved from validated internal configuration, not unauthenticated user-supplied query parameters.

name: LLM Profiles Internet Egress NetworkPolicy Permissiveness Claim
description: Flagging 0.0.0.0/0 outbound egress in LLM profiles NetworkPolicy as overly permissive, ignoring that inference engines must download model weights from public model hubs.
resolution: LLM backend pods require outbound internet egress to download model weights from HuggingFace and public model registries; metadata service (169.254.169.254/32) is explicitly blocked.

name: Decommissioned AI Backend URL Resolution Claim
description: Claiming that _resolve_backend_url lacks resolution for decommissioned backends like LightLLM, which were intentionally removed under pre-1.0 zero backwards compatibility standards.
resolution: LightLLM was deliberately decommissioned from CONST_AI_BACKENDS and runtime configurations under pre-1.0 zero backwards compatibility standards.
